existing_features.title: Create a reusable React/TypeScript image component that encapsulates common image behavior (loading attributes, error handling, and a visual fallback) so the app has a single, consistent “image code” pattern.
Refactor existing image usages to use the new reusable image component for consistency, specifically in `BrandLogo` and the service category cards grid.
